description: This file defines the 'Forgotten' controller class for the Opencart admin panel, handling password reset workflows including displaying forms, confirming email, resetting tokens, and updating passwords.

classes.name: Forgotten
classes.description: Controller class for handling password forgotten/reset processes in the Opencart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the forgotten password entry form with breadcrumb navigation.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Handles the submission of the email for password reset, generating a token and redirecting on success or error.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Displays the password reset form, verifying the reset token and associated email.

methods.name: password
methods.description: Processes the new password submission, validates input, updates the user's password, and clears reset tokens.
